theater: 亞美尼亞巴格雷萬德平原

battle.name: 巴格雷萬德戰役
battle.theater: 亞美尼亞巴格雷萬德平原
battle.brief: 七七五年四月二十五日，哈里發曼蘇爾以三萬呼羅珊兵平定亞美尼亞貴族之亂，在巴格雷萬德高原擊潰以斯姆巴特七世與穆舍格六世為首的聯軍。卡面秦弩早於本役近千年，不可能原樣出現在這片戰場，但它代表的存力擊發原理，正是阿拔斯軍中弩手與亞美尼亞弓騎交鋒時的火力骨架。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 本役是阿拔斯哈里發國在亞美尼亞邊區與亞美尼亞貴族聯軍之間的一場決戰，交戰地點在今日土耳其東部穆什一帶的高原盆地。哈里發國一方由哈里發曼蘇爾坐鎮都城，命令呼羅珊方向的主力南下：一支號稱三萬人的呼羅珊兵團由阿米爾·本·伊斯馬伊爾率領，經呼羅珊、裏海、亞美尼亞的行軍線壓入戰區；亞美尼亞總督哈桑·本·哈塔巴只掌握邊鎮守軍與稅吏，既無力平叛，屢次請援也等不到兵，於是事件一路升級到哈里發御前。哈里發國的邊區體系本來建立在契約之上：封君（納哈拉爾）由哈里發撥給俸祿、牧場與司法特權，阿拉伯稅吏進駐城鎮徵收稅賦，換取的是封君的效忠與兵源；一旦俸祿停發、稅負加重，邊區的軍政關係便迅速崩解。亞美尼亞一方不是國家，而是以馬米科尼安、巴格拉圖尼等家族為骨幹的貴族聯軍，各家首領自領私兵、自備甲胄，軍紀與戰術意圖全憑血緣維持；其中巴格拉圖尼家族原為哈里發國最可靠的附庸之一，阿爾茲魯尼與西夫尼兩家則在起義中保持中立，觀望風向。值得放在同一個年份裡看的，是阿拔斯國在東方的另一條戰線：七七五年，哈里發曼蘇爾在位末期，呼羅珊方向的軍隊重新控制了河中地區，把唐軍的西征軍隊逼回蔥嶺以西，東西兩端的邊界在同一個年份裡一齊收束。
countriesEn: This was a decisive engagement between the Abbasid Caliphate and a coalition of Armenian noble houses in the Armenian borderlands, fought in the highland basins of what is now eastern Turkey, in the Bagrevand plain. On the caliphal side the caliph al-Mansur stayed in the capital and ordered the main body of the Khurasan army south: a corps numbered at thirty thousand men under Amir ibn Isma'il marched by the Khurasan, Caspian and Armenia route into the province. The Arab governor of Armenia, al-Hasan ibn Qahtaba, held only the frontier garrisons and the tax collectors, and being unable to hold down the rising and unable to make his appeals heard, he let the matter travel to the caliph's desk. The caliphal frontier system rested on a contract: the princes, the nakharar, were given stipends, pastures and judicial privileges by the caliph, and Arab tax officials lived in the towns, in return for the loyalty and the soldiers of the clients; once the stipends were stopped and the taxes raised, the military and political relationship came apart almost at once. The Armenian side was not a state but a coalition of noble houses built around the Mamikonian, Bagratuni and other families, each leader bringing his own retainers, armour and horses, with discipline and tactical intent resting on blood ties rather than institutions; the Bagratuni, formerly among the most dependable clients of the caliphate, were among those who turned, while the Artsruni and the Siwni held themselves neutral through the rising and watched which way the wind blew. It is worth setting the battle in the same year as the caliphate's other front: in 775, in the last months of al-Mansur's reign, the armies from Khurasan re-established control over Transoxiana and pushed the Tang expeditionary army back beyond the Congling range, so that the frontiers at both ends of the empire closed in during the same year.
people: 阿米爾·本·伊斯馬伊爾是哈里發國一方的戰場指揮官，他領著從呼羅珊調來的兵團進入亞美尼亞，負責把反叛壓回盆地；此役之後他的名字與這場鎮壓綁在一起，其後更在七七八年的拜占庭邊境戰線上統率阿拔斯軍。亞美尼亞方面掛名督戰的兩位首領都死在沙場：巴格拉圖尼家族的斯姆巴特七世，素來被視為哈里發國在亞美尼亞最親密的附庸，卻在起義中倒向本族；馬米科尼安家族的穆舍格六世則是起義的武力柱石之一，與起義的發動者阿爾塔瓦茲德·馬米科尼安同族，前線的兵權在他手上。起義的真正首腦是阿爾塔瓦茲德，他自七七四年起號召諸部反抗，策劃了對阿拉伯稅吏與稅站的攻擊，使原本零星的抵抗擴散成全境叛亂。哈里發曼蘇爾本人沒有到前線，但正是他停發封君俸祿、加徵稅賦、縱容對基督徒人口的壓迫，把貴族推上戰場；同年十月他在麥加朝覽的返程途中病逝，由其子曼迪（al-Mahdi）繼位，新君對亞美尼亞的清洗在隔年更趨嚴酷。還有一位關鍵而失敗的角色：亞美尼亞總督哈桑·本·哈塔巴，他既無兵又無權，收拾不了的殘局連他自己也沒有善終，據記載他因涉嫌巴馬基黨人一案，於同年被曼蘇爾處死。
peopleEn: Amir ibn Isma'il was the battlefield commander on the caliphal side, leading the corps drawn from Khurasan into Armenia and responsible for crushing the rising back into the plain; after this battle his name was bound to the suppression, and he went on to command the caliphal armies on the Byzantine frontier in 778. The two leaders who fought for Armenia died on the field: Smbat VII of the Bagratuni, generally treated as the closest of the caliphate's Armenian clients, had turned to his own house, and Mushegh VI of the Mamikonian was one of the armed pillars of the rising, of the same house as Artavazd Mamikonian who had set it in motion, and the field command was in his hands. The real political leader of the revolt was Artavazd, who from 774 called the houses to arms and planned the attacks on Arab tax officials and tax stations, turning scattered resistance into a general rebellion. Caliph al-Mansur himself never came to the front, but it was he who stopped the stipends to the princes, raised the taxes and tolerated the pressure on the Christian population, and that is what put the nobility on the battlefield; later the same year, in October, he fell ill on his way back from the pilgrimage to Mecca and died, his son al-Mahdi succeeding him, and the purge of the Armenian houses grew harsher in the following year. One more figure belongs in the story, and he is the failed one: the Arab governor of Armenia, al-Hasan ibn Qahtaba, who had neither troops nor authority; the revolt he could not contain cost him his own life, for the records have him executed by al-Mansur in the same year on suspicion of complicity in the Barmakid affair.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩不屬於七七五年：它是公元前二世紀的弩機式武器，靠弦與機關把拉力存住，發射時只須扣下扳機；中國的弩在漢代已配上蹶張器上弦，箭壓在弩槽中待發，一個射手可以連續送出密集的箭雨。到八世紀，這個原理早已沿著絲路西傳，薩珊與拜占庭的軍隊都使用弩，阿拉伯人在征服敘利亞與埃及之後也把它收編進軍制，阿拉伯文獻裡的「奈爾」（nawr）指的正是弩；同期唐軍在西域使用的擘張弩、腰張弩與床弩，和拜占庭式的輕型手弩，源頭都是同一個中國發明。本役的裝備細節，現存史料幾乎只留下人數與地名，沒有留下陣中弩手的編制與射擊方式，只能從同期阿拔斯軍的樣貌類推。呼羅珊兵團是八世紀阿拔斯軍中最以弓箭聞名的一支：步兵以弓為主，配長矛與短劍，其中弩手為數不少，騎兵則分輕裝弓騎與重甲突擊兵兩端；亞美尼亞貴族的私兵以各家自備的騎兵與弓箭手為主，鱗甲、札甲與長槍是當時亞美尼亞與拜占庭騎兵的常態配置。若以同期其他戰役類比，巴格拉圖尼與馬米科尼安兩家的失勢，很大程度上不是輸在各自的弓弩，而是輸在對方能把三萬人、數千具弩與整套後勤壓在同一個平原有機會整合，而貴族聯軍的火力分散在各家的私兵，無法結成集中的弩陣與齊射。卡面秦弩的真正位置在這裡：它不是一件現場的戰利品，而是本役勝負的物理尺度，誰能先把力量存起來，誰就能在平原上用箭的密度換取騎兵的衝鋒空間。
kitsEn: The crossbow on this card does not belong to 775: it is a machine of the second century BC that stores the draw in the string and the trigger, so that the shot needs nothing but the release of the catch; by the Han the Chinese crossbow was already cocked with a stirrup, the bolt lay ready in the groove, and a single archer could send out a dense succession of shots. By the eighth century the principle had long since travelled west along the Silk Road: Sasanian and Byzantine armies used crossbows, and the Arabs took the weapon into their own order after the conquests of Syria and Egypt, the crossbow appearing in Arabic literature under the name nawr. The crossbows of the Tang in the western regions, the belly-drawn and the bed crossbow, and the light hand crossbow of the Byzantine type all descend from that single Chinese invention. Details of the armament in this battle are simply not preserved: the surviving accounts give numbers and a place name, and nothing about the organisation of crossbowmen in the line or the way they shot, so the equipment can only be inferred from what the Abbasid armies of the same generation looked like. The Khurasani corps was the corps of the Abbasid army most famous for its archery: infantry whose principal weapon was the bow, with spears and short swords, and a substantial number of crossbowmen among them, while the cavalry ranged from light horse archers to armoured shock troops. The private troops of the Armenian princes were chiefly the mounted and foot archers each house maintained for itself, with lamellar and scale armour and long spears the standing equipment of Armenian and Byzantine cavalry of the day. Compared with the battles of the same period, the fall of the Bagratuni and the Mamikonian had less to do with their own bows than with the fact that the other side could bring thirty thousand men, several thousand crossbows and a whole supply system into the same plain and hold them together there, while the firepower of the coalition was split among separate households and could never be massed into a crossbow line or a simultaneous volley. That is where the crossbow on the card really sits: it is not an object picked up from the field, it is the physical measure of the result, and whoever can store the force first buys the space in which cavalry can charge.
tactics: 本役的作戰過程記載極少，現存的敘述多出自編年史家與近代史家的政治分析，幾乎沒有陣形與行軍的細節。能確定的有以下幾點。第一，交戰在四月二十五日一天之內結束，說明雙方並未進行曠日持久的圍城或營壘對峙，而是一次在開闊高原上的會合式決戰；巴格雷萬德是穆什盆地一類的寬闊草場，東西兩側山嶺夾峙，地面開闊而可蔭蔽處有限，既利於集結的騎兵展開，也利於數量取勝的一方包抄。第二，阿拔斯軍自呼羅珊方向沿山道長驅而來，戰術意圖很清楚：把人馬集中在一點，以三萬之眾正面壓上，不給反叛聯軍逐家消耗的機會；一旦兩位首領陣亡，各家私兵失去號令，潰散便無法收拾。第三，貴族聯軍的弱點在指揮分散：斯姆巴特七世與穆舍格六世各自率本部出戰，彼此協同靠血緣而非制度，聯軍一旦被切斷，首領們便各自為戰，最容易被分別包圍。第四，就當時的兵器而言，弩手的齊射是數百步內唯一能把騎兵壓住的手段：密集的弩陣可以打斷衝鋒的節奏，迫使對方散開，而散開正是包圍得以形成的前提。第四點是依同期戰役的通例所作的推斷，不是本役的直接記載；可以確定的是首領陣亡這一結果本身，已經說明聯軍在正面消耗中先行崩解，其後的追擊與清剿只是收尾。
tacticsEn: The record of how this battle was fought is thin: what survives comes from the chroniclers and from modern political analysis, and it contains almost nothing about formations and marching. A few things can be fixed. First, the fighting was over within the single day of 25 April, which says that this was not a long siege or a stand-off between entrenched camps, but a meeting engagement decided on open ground: Bagrevand is a wide meadow of the kind found in the Mush basin, flanked by mountain ridges to east and west, with much open space and little cover, which suits a massed cavalry and equally suits a side that can outnumber its opponent. Second, the Abbasid army had marched the long way from Khurasan along the mountain tracks, and its tactical purpose was plain: to concentrate its force at a single point and press forward with thirty thousand men, so that the rebel coalition was never allowed to wear its units down one house at a time; once the two chiefs were killed, the private levies lost their orders and the dispersal could not be arrested. Third, the weakness of the coalition lay in divided command: Smbat VII and Mushegh VI brought their own contingents to the field, and their cooperation rested on kinship rather than on any institution, so that once the coalition was cut apart the chiefs fought each for himself and were the easiest of all to be surrounded one by one. Fourth, in terms of the weapons of the day, a volley of crossbowmen was the only means of holding cavalry at bay over several hundred paces: a dense line of crossbows could break the rhythm of a charge and force the attackers to spread out, and spreading out is the precondition for encirclement. That fourth point is an inference drawn from the general practice of contemporary battles and not a direct record of this one; what is certain is that the death of the two chiefs shows the coalition disintegrating under frontal pressure, and the pursuit and the mopping-up that followed were only the tidying at the end.
data: 關於本役的數字，可靠的只有以下幾項。日期最為確定：一七七五年四月二十五日，交戰在同一天內結束，沒有跨日的攻守紀錄。哈里發國出兵規模留下一個明確數字：曼蘇爾下令從呼羅珊調三萬人，由阿米爾·本·伊斯馬伊爾率領；這是編年史留下的唯一兵力數字，通常被視為阿拔斯方面調兵的上限，而非實到之數。亞美尼亞聯軍的總數沒有留下可靠記載，只能從家族結構推知：起義得到大部分納哈拉爾家族的支持，另有阿爾茲魯尼與西夫尼兩家保持中立，因此聯軍人數分散在數個家族的部眾之間，總量難以估算。損失方面，史料只確認斯姆巴特七世與穆舍格六世陣亡，以及起義隨後遭到殘酷鎮壓，此外沒有可用的數字，本役傷亡的多寡不宜推測。地理上，巴格雷萬德一般被認為即今土耳其東部的穆什盆地，戰場距亞美尼亞總督駐地迪文約三百餘公里，軍隊須越過山嶺才能進入平原；平原海拔高，四月下旬尚有融雪，地面鬆軟泥濘，會直接限制騎兵的衝鋒速度與持久力。時間層面上，這一戰落在哈里發曼蘇爾在位的最後幾個月，同年十月他病逝，由其子曼迪繼位；同年阿拔斯國在東方也完成對河中地區的重新控制，唐軍的西征軍隊最終退出蔥嶺以西，東西兩條戰線在同一個年份收束。
dataEn: Only a few figures for this battle can be relied on. The date is the firmest of them: 25 April 775, with the fighting over within the same day and no record of any attack or defence running across days. The size of the caliphal expedition is given as an explicit number: al-Mansur ordered thirty thousand men drawn from Khurasan under Amir ibn Isma'il; this is the only strength figure the chroniclers leave, and it is usually read as the ceiling of what the caliph could muster rather than the number that actually arrived. No reliable figure survives for the Armenian coalition, and it can only be inferred from the structure of the houses: the rising had the support of most of the nakharar, while the Artsruni and the Siwni stood apart, so the strength was divided among the retainers of several families and cannot be totalled. On losses, the sources confirm only that Smbat VII and Mushegh VI were killed and that the revolt was afterwards suppressed with great severity; there is no usable casualty figure, and the scale of the bloodshed here should not be guessed at. Geographically, Bagrevand is generally identified with the Mush basin in eastern Turkey, the battlefield lying some three hundred kilometres from Dvin, the seat of the Armenian governor, the army having to cross the mountains to reach the plain. The plain stands at high altitude, and with the snow still melting in late April the ground is soft and boggy, which bears directly on the speed and endurance of any cavalry charge. In time, the battle falls in the last months of al-Mansur's reign; he died in October of the same year and was succeeded by his son al-Mahdi. In that same year the caliphate also re-established its hold on Transoxiana in the east, and the Tang expeditionary army finally withdrew from beyond the Congling range: both ends of the empire's frontier were drawn in within a single year.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因，是阿拔斯哈里發國對亞美尼亞邊區的統治方式轉硬。先王薩法赫在七四七至七五〇年間以極其暴烈的方式平定了亞美尼亞貴族的第一次大反叛；輪到曼蘇爾在位，邊區的安排沒有放寬，反而收緊：他取消了歷來撥給封君的俸祿，又加徵沉重的稅賦，基督徒人口在稅吏、徵糧與改宗壓力下不堪其擾。於是七七四年，馬米科尼安家族的阿爾塔瓦茲德起兵號召，多數納哈拉爾家族響應，連一向親阿拉伯的巴格拉圖尼家也反了；亞美尼亞總督哈桑·本·哈塔巴無力平叛，起義席捲全省，直指阿拉伯稅站與稅吏。深層的背景，是八世紀之前阿拔斯國對邊區的依附體系：哈里發以俸祿、牧場與司法特權換取封君的效忠與兵源，雙方的關係本來是契約式的，一旦契約被單方面撕毀，貴族的反彈就會變成全面叛亂。值得放在同一年裡看的是東方：同一個七七五年，阿拔斯國把唐軍的西征擋回蔥嶺以西，東西兩端的疆界都在收束。這個巧合說明，曼蘇爾在位末期把整個帝國推向一種更硬、更集權、也更倚重軍隊的治理方式：對亞美尼亞是停俸、加稅、進兵，對東方是重整呼羅珊兵團。本役正是這條政策在亞美尼亞高原上的第一次大規模實現。
causeEn: The immediate origin of the war was a hardening in the way the Abbasid caliphate governed its Armenian borderlands. The caliph al-Saffah had put down the first great rising of the Armenian nobility in 747 to 750 with extreme violence; under al-Mansur the arrangement was not relaxed but tightened: he stopped the stipends paid to the princes, the nakharar, and added heavy taxes, while the Christian population, ground down by tax collectors, levies and pressure to convert, could bear it no longer. So in 774 Artavazd of the Mamikonian called the houses to arms, most of the nakharar answered, even the Bagratuni, long friendly to the Arabs, turned against the caliphate, and al-Hasan ibn Qahtaba, the Arab governor of Armenia, could not hold the province together; the rising swept the whole land and struck directly at the Arab tax stations and tax collectors. Behind this lay the whole structure of the Abbasid frontier in the eighth century: the caliph exchanged stipends, pastures and judicial privileges for the loyalty and the soldiers of the client princes, and the relationship was a contract between two parties. When one side tore the contract up by itself, the grievance of the nobles turned into general rebellion. It is worth setting the battle in the same year as events in the east: in 775 the caliphate held the Tang expeditionary army back beyond the Congling range as well, and the frontiers at both ends of the empire closed within the same twelve months. The coincidence says something about al-Mansur's last years: he was pushing the whole empire towards a harder, more centralised and more military way of governing, for Armenia stop the stipends, raise the taxes, send in the troops, and for the east rebuild the Khurasan corps. This battle was the first large-scale execution of that policy on the Armenian highland.
impact: 這場勝利對外高加索政治是一次分水嶺。史家惠托把巴格雷萬德視為外高加索政治的分水嶺：貴族聯軍作為一個整體被消滅，馬米科尼安、格納尼、阿瑪圖尼、魯什圖尼、薩哈魯尼與卡姆薩拉坎等家族一時失去原有的軍事與政治分量，倖存者或淪為其他家族的附庸，或西徙拜占庭寄居；巴格拉圖尼家一度退入山間據點，卻在九世紀重新取得亞美尼亞的主要地位。留局觀望的阿爾茲魯尼家則因這場戰役造成的權力真空而崛起，得以坐鎮瓦斯普拉坎。反過來看，阿拔斯國在鎮壓之後對亞美尼亞的整合反而更深：接下來數年，亞美尼亞本土的基督徒貴族遭到清洗，七八〇年代在鄰近的伊比利亞也進行了類似的清除，同時推行讓阿拉伯穆斯林在新征服地區定居的政策，結果到九世紀之交，低地與城鎮中的阿拉伯人口已佔多數，進入十世紀，高加索阿爾巴尼亞幾乎全面伊斯蘭化，伊比利亞與亞美尼亞大部則落入一系列阿拉伯埃米爾的統治之下。另一條較少被注意的後果，是西徙的亞美尼亞貴族與其武裝部眾把拜占庭的邊防經驗帶了過去，此後拜占庭帝國的軍隊與邊境行政中，亞美尼亞人屢見不鮮，成為帝國在九至十一世紀的重要軍事資源。裝備與技術層面則沒有戲劇性的變化：弩仍是那一帶常規的守城與野戰武器，這場仗沒有改變弓弩在兩軍中的地位，改變的是誰能集結更多的弩手與更完整的補給。
impactEn: The victory was a watershed in Transcaucasian politics. The historian Whittow calls Bagrevand a watershed in the politics of the Transcaucasus: the noble coalition was destroyed as a whole, and the Mamikonian, Gnuni, Amatuni, Rshtuni, Saharuni and Kamsarakan houses for a time lost their military and political weight, those who survived becoming dependants of other houses or exiles in Byzantium; the Bagratuni withdrew for a time to their mountain strongholds and recovered a dominant position in Armenia during the ninth century. The Artsruni, who had switched to the caliphate in time, profited from the power vacuum and rose to power in Vaspurakan. In the other direction, the Abbasid integration of Armenia went deeper after the suppression: the native Christian nobility was purged in the years that followed, a similar purge was carried out in neighbouring Iberia in the 780s, and a settlement policy moved increasing numbers of Arab Muslims into the Transcaucasus, with the effect that by the turn of the ninth century the Arab element predominated in the towns and the lowlands; in the next century Caucasian Albania was effectively Islamicised, while Iberia and much of Armenia came under a series of Arab emirates. A less noticed consequence was that the Armenian princes and their armed followers who went west carried Byzantine frontier experience with them, and Armenian men are thereafter a recurring presence in the armies and the frontier administration of the Byzantine empire, an important military resource of the empire in the ninth to eleventh centuries. At the level of equipment and technique nothing dramatic changed: the crossbow remained the standard close-defence and field weapon of the region, this battle did not alter the standing of bow and crossbow in either army, and what changed was who could muster more crossbowmen and a more complete supply system.
result: 七七五年四月二十五日，巴格雷萬德平原上的一日之戰決定了亞美尼亞貴族聯軍的命運。阿拔斯軍以三萬呼羅珊兵正面壓上，聯軍兩位主將斯姆巴特七世與穆舍格六世陣亡，各家私兵在失去號令之後潰散，亞美尼亞總督哈桑·本·哈塔巴重獲對省內的控制，起義隨即被殘酷鎮壓。對哈里發國而言，這是一場乾淨的邊疆平叛：曼蘇爾不必再年年撥付封君俸祿，亞美尼亞的稅賦與牧場重新收歸哈里發國的帳目，邊區也從契約式的羈縻變成直接管理的省。對亞美尼亞貴族而言，這是一場世代性的塌陷：主要家族在一夕之間失去土地、部眾與兵源，倖存者淪為附庸或流亡，成為阿拔斯國改造高加索的樣板；而在拜占庭邊境那邊，這場敗仗的餘波成為大批亞美尼亞武裝部眾西徙的起點。若把時序拉長，巴格雷萬德的結果是：阿拔斯國在八世紀末把外高加索從鬆散的依附體系收進了自己的稅制、駐軍與定居政策之中，這條路走到十世紀，換來的是高加索低地的伊斯蘭化與一批不斷西遷的亞美尼亞軍人；同一年的怛羅斯之役則讓阿拔斯國在東方把唐軍擋在蔥嶺之外。兩場勝利都在同一年，指向同一件事：這是一個王朝在收緊。實際下手的時候，攻城的人靠的不是攻城塔，而是城牆上那具已經張好、只等扣板的弩機。
resultEn: On 25 April 775 the single day of fighting in the plain of Bagrevand settled the fate of the Armenian noble coalition. The Abbasid army pressed forward with thirty thousand Khurasani men, the two commanders of the coalition, Smbat VII and Mushegh VI, were killed, the private levies scattered once they had lost their orders, and al-Hasan ibn Qahtaba recovered his authority over the province, after which the rising was suppressed with great severity. For the caliphate this was a clean frontier rising put down: al-Mansur no longer had to pay stipends to the princes year by year, the taxes and pastures of Armenia went back into the caliph's accounts, and the borderland changed from clientage by contract into a province directly administered. For the Armenian nobility it was a generational collapse: the great houses lost land, followers and soldiers in a single day, and those who survived were reduced to dependants or exile, becoming the template for the caliphate's remaking of the Caucasus. On the Byzantine side, the shock of the defeat set off the movement west of large numbers of Armenian armed followers. Draw the thread out longer and the result of Bagrevand is this: by the end of the eighth century the Abbasid caliphate had drawn the Transcaucasus out of a loose system of clientage and into its own taxation, its garrisons and its settlement policy, and along that road the tenth century brought the Islamisation of the Caucasian lowlands and a stream of Armenian soldiers moving west. The battle of Talas in the same year pushed the Tang armies back beyond the Congling range in the east. Both victories belong to the same year and point to the same thing: this was a dynasty tightening its grip. And at the moment of impact it was not siege towers that did the work, but the crossbow on the wall, already cocked, waiting only for the trigger.
